runtime.lifetime: persistent for the Python TRT object lifetime

engine.lifetime: persistent while the engine wrapper is retained

execution_context.lifetime: one function-call-local Python reference; released on run return

stream.lifetime: persistent for the Python TRT object lifetime

bindings_and_addresses.input_addresses: set in every TRT.run call from the caller's tensors
bindings_and_addresses.output_tensors: allocated in every TRT.run call and returned to caller
bindings_and_addresses.kv_cache: passed as caller-owned tensors on each decode call; prefix/isolation semantics handled by Phase 2 runtime

persistence_strategy.mapping: one persistent context per persistent engine wrapper
persistence_strategy.address_policy: continue setting every input/output address on every run

notes: No repeated Runtime or Engine deserialization was found in the hot path.
Persistent mode must preserve legacy mode behind an explicit flag and still update shapes/addresses every call.
